entries.title: Lead engine: sales was guessing who to call
entries.summary: Automated pipeline brings Meta Lead Ads, website and email leads into the CRM via API; NLP and deep learning score leads from CRM attributes, interaction history and salesperson remarks.
entries.details: About 1 lakh records processed without manual handling. MLflow for experiment tracking, versioning and serving. Scores sit inside the sales workflow so reps call high-probability leads first. Model internals are confidential; only outcomes are shared.

entries.title: KPI system: four functions, no single truth
entries.summary: Defined and documented 12+ cross-functional KPIs with agreed definitions and data lineage, then built 6+ Power BI dashboards.

entries.title: CRM automation: follow-ups were manual and leaky
entries.summary: Gathered CRM automation requirements, wrote acceptance criteria and ran UAT.

entries.title: Shop floor: idle machines, invisible lost time
entries.summary: Real-time production dashboards plus SPC gave continuous-improvement reviews their first quantitative baseline.

entries.title: Hospital workflows
entries.summary: Mapped dataflows and documented 15+ user workflows across three hospital modules.

entries.title: Supply chain KPI automation
entries.summary: SQL ETL into Power BI and Tableau with data-quality checks, replacing a two-day manual reporting cycle.

entries.title: Car price prediction
entries.summary: Artificial neural network on 8,000+ CarDekho listings; outperformed linear regression on RMSE.

entries.title: Social media revenue mapping
entries.summary: 10,000+ data points across four social channels; engagement-to-revenue correlation in Python and Excel.

entries.title: Ask Mahi (this assistant)
entries.summary: A portfolio assistant: NVIDIA Nemotron answers using read-only MCP tools over a curated Google Drive knowledge folder; chats are summarised by email.
